title: Dangerous Razor-Sharp Corner Tips
text: Dangerous Razor-Sharp Corner Tips. All 4 corner tips at the top are razor sharp. Please put your fingertip on the pointy-ends of the 4 top corners. Sharp as a knife and dangerous, especially with kids.  Uncomfortably and scary sharp at the 4 top corners.

product_metadata.title: SimplyImagine Countertop Paper Towel Holder Dispenser - Black Acrylic Storage Holder for Kitchen or Bathroom Use for Multifold, C Fold, Trifold, Z Fold Hand Towel Napkins - Commercial or Home Use
features: SIMPLE TO USE - Simply add standard single stack package of Multifold, C Fold, Trifold, Z Fold paper towels into paper towel holder. The holder is custom size to fit these paper towels perfectly. No extra space wasted! Measures 10.75" x 6.5" x 4".

KEEP THE AREA CLEAN - Keep your kitchen or bathroom looking clean and spotless with one of the best investments your family and guests will love. Have clean towels every time they're needed! No more wet towels.

BEST CONSTRUCTION - Very durable and sturdy, can be used in residential or commercial settings and withstand constant use. Simply place on countertop in desired location. Easy to pull one exposed paper towel from the top of the pile!

LOOKS FANTASTIC - Bring commercial paper towels into the kitchen or bathroom in an elegant way. The style is simple enough to fit any decor. Clean, clear dispenser that is both stylish and functional.
